description:
Ready to master the most challenging part of the Google Cloud Professional Architect exam? This video is a dedicated deep dive into three official case studies: **TerramEarth**, **JencoMart**, and **Dress4Win**, covering real exam questions **159-187**.

Passing the exam in 2025 requires a deep understanding of how to apply GCP services to complex business problems. This session is designed to give you that exact skill.

In this deep dive, you will master how to architect solutions for:
✅ **TerramEarth (Manufacturing/IoT):** Designing scalable IoT data ingestion pipelines, building predictive maintenance models with BigQuery, and managing massive datasets for heavy equipment fleets.
✅ **JencoMart (Global Retail):** Architecting modern data warehousing solutions, designing for peak retail traffic, and creating platforms for business analytics and reporting.
✅ **Dress4Win (E-commerce):** Building resilient, scalable microservices architectures, implementing robust CI/CD pipelines for a web-based company, and selecting the right database services.

We don't just give you the answers—we teach you the architectural mindset needed to solve any case study scenario thrown at you.

▶️ **WATCH THE FULL 250+ QUESTION PLAYLIST HERE:**
